name: legacy-project-onboarding
description: Recommended MCP/plugin profile for applying AgentForge to brownfield or legacy codebases.

recommended_mcp_servers.why: Read local legacy project files and subfolders that are not already in the assistant context.
Inspect issues, pull requests, commit history, ownership, and release evidence.
Persist durable project facts across onboarding and modernization sessions.
Lookup current framework and library documentation while auditing old dependencies.
Validate browser behavior and create regression evidence for UI-heavy legacy apps.
Optional for large legacy estates where independent agents should map subsystems in parallel.

safety_gates: Add characterization tests for critical flows.
Use subfolder CLAUDE.md files where commands or conventions differ.
Create ADRs for modernization boundaries, migration strategy, or framework changes.
Run /quality-gate and relevant language reviewers before PR.
